prompt.request:
Return exactly one JSON object matching the schema, never an array. Write investigate(context, acquire) in Python. acquire("events") returns records with event_id and work. Return {"findings": [], "unresolved": [], "ratio": sum of work once per unique event_id}. Duplicate deliveries repeat exactly. Distinct IDs with equal work must both count. No imports, top-level assignments, annotations or default function arguments. This is an interface canary, not a research evaluation.
Put the COMPLETE EXECUTABLE PYTHON PROGRAM in source. scope and lesson are short claims; source must contain function definition and body, never a label or signature.

source.description: The COMPLETE EXECUTABLE PYTHON PROGRAM defining investigate(context, acquire) and helper functions, with full bodies. Never a label, signature, prose instruction, placeholder or code fence.

selection_reason: Separately authorized explicit source-field interface revision; no retry or overwrite of any earlier attempt.

runtime_source.scope: Python implementation, research runners, native graphs/contracts and master configuration; no credentials or run payloads
